recognize_zh: 周邊血液可見數個中小型淋巴球，核偏心、胞質淡藍且邊緣略不規則、呈極性分布（villous/plasmacytoid 外觀）；附圖顯示竇內（intrasinusoidal）線狀陽性細胞與包圍生發中心的邊緣區環狀染色，符合脾邊緣區淋巴瘤（SMZL）。
features: Small to medium-sized lymphocytes with round to slightly oval, eccentric nuclei and condensed chromatin
Moderate pale-blue cytoplasm, often polar, with slightly irregular or short villous borders
No prominent nucleoli; no circumferential hairy projections
Red cells without conspicuous rouleaux in this field
Inset IHC shows a linear, intrasinusoidal cluster of positive lymphoid cells
Tissue H&E shows a dense small lymphoid infiltrate; IHC highlights a marginal-zone ring surrounding a negative follicle center
describe_en: Composite figure. The peripheral blood smear (A) shows several abnormal small to medium lymphocytes with eccentric nuclei, condensed chromatin and moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm that is frequently polar with irregular, short villous margins; nucleoli are inconspicuous and circumferential hairy projections are not seen. Rouleaux are not conspicuous in this field despite the clinical history of hyperviscosity. Immunohistochemistry (B) shows a linear intrasinusoidal cluster of positive cells, the H&E section (C) shows a dense small lymphoid infiltrate, and immunostaining (D) outlines a marginal-zone-pattern ring around a follicle (antibodies not labeled). Findings are consistent with splenic marginal zone lymphoma; hyperviscosity is a clinical/laboratory diagnosis and requires paraprotein and viscosity measurement.

ddx.vs: LPL is the classic cause of IgM hyperviscosity and shows a lymphoplasmacytic marrow infiltrate with MYD88 L265P, whereas SMZL shows villous lymphocytes, splenic marginal-zone pattern and intrasinusoidal marrow involvement with MYD88 usually wild type.
Hairy cells have circumferential fine projections and oval/bean-shaped nuclei with CD103, CD25, CD11c, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E, unlike the polar short villi seen here.
CLL cells are small with scant cytoplasm, soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells, and are CD5+/CD23+, whereas these cells have more cytoplasm with polar villi.
MCL cells often have irregular notched nuclei and are CD5+ with cyclin D1/SOX11 expression and t(11;14).
